back: Check: Missing lock; struct padding races · Fix: Mutex or lock-free ring; align structs; volatile is not a lock

front: Symptom: EINVAL on shmat — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Size mismatch; destroyed segment · Fix: Recreate with agreed size; lifecycle protocol

front: Symptom: Leaked SysV segments after crash — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ipcs -m · Fix: ipcrm; use POSIX names + shm_unlink on shutdown

front: Symptom: Container can't see host shm — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: IPC namespace isolation · Fix: --ipc=host (careful) or named volume/socket design

front: Gotcha with Shared memory: what silently fails?
back: Cache coherency is CPU-level, not magic — still need memory barriers for lock-free structures.

front: When should you NOT use Shared memory?
back: Prefer message passing (socket, pipe) when you need clear ownership boundaries, cross-machine IPC, or untrusted peers. Shared memory shines for high-throughput same-machine data (video frames, ring buffers, DB buffer pools).
